podcast.title: Churg-Strauss Syndrome
podcast.body: Ben Watt of the British band Everything But The Girl suffers from Churg-Strauss syndrome, a rare disease characterized by inflammation of the blood vessels. The condition often begins with asthma and then spreads throughout the body, potentially causing organ damage in severe cases. While there is no cure, treatments such as steroids and immunosuppressant drugs can be beneficial. "Ben Watts of the British band Everything But The Girl has trigstrow syndrome, a disease that causes inflammation of the blood vessels."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Hospitalization and Lasting Effects
podcast.body: Ben Watt was first hospitalized in 1992 due to Churg-Strauss syndrome, an experience he later chronicled in his memoir, *Patient*. During this period, he tragically lost his voice and a substantial portion of his intestine, leaving him with only about 20% of his digestive system intact. "He lost his voice and a big chunk of his intestine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
